contracts.purpose: Identify a component and its immutable source/build revision.
contracts.semantics: component_id is stable within a workcell; version is SemVer 2.

contracts.purpose: Reference immutable validated configuration without embedding it.
contracts.semantics: content_hash is algorithm-prefixed and resolves to exact content.

contracts.purpose: Relate build, configuration, and calibration provenance.
contracts.semantics: An empty calibration ID means calibration does not apply.

contracts.purpose: Describe one stable device instance and its capabilities.
contracts.semantics: Two devices using one adapter have distinct device_id values.

contracts.purpose: Report lifecycle, availability, connection, and diagnostics.
contracts.semantics: State is observational at header.stamp and does not request transitions.

contracts.purpose: Provide a bounded point-in-time state snapshot.
contracts.semantics: Entries are correlated by device_id, never array position.

contracts.purpose: Reference immutable calibration and its frame pair.
contracts.semantics: Frames follow REP-103 and content is external.

contracts.purpose: List registered descriptors and current states.
contracts.semantics: Descriptor and state responses are joined by device_id.

contracts.purpose: Read descriptor and state for one stable device ID.
contracts.semantics: reason is empty on success and machine-readable state remains in fields.

contracts.purpose: Represent robot-independent teleoperator pose and input state.
contracts.semantics: SI units and REP-103 frame; gripper is normalized to [0,1].

contracts.purpose: Represent an absolute or delta Cartesian command with lease and deadline.
contracts.semantics: A zero or expired deadline and an empty reference frame are invalid.

contracts.purpose: Represent named joint targets with lease and deadline.
contracts.semantics: Value arrays are empty or exactly aligned with joint_names.

contracts.purpose: Describe an exclusive, time-bounded command ownership grant.
contracts.semantics: expires_at is later than issued_at; arbitration is not encoded.

contracts.purpose: Report the observable state and last transition reason of a lease.
contracts.semantics: Status does not imply client-side arbitration authority.

contracts.purpose: Declare a source, mapper, solver, and target relationship.
contracts.semantics: Mapping implementation and configuration content remain external.

contracts.purpose: Report enabled, eligible, and ownership state for a binding.
contracts.semantics: A lease UUID is meaningful only when owns_command_lease is true.

contracts.purpose: Report current safety level and motion permission.
contracts.semantics: Observable status only; policy and stopping behavior are external.

contracts.purpose: Record a timestamped safety transition, limit, or rejection.
contracts.semantics: All-zero command UUID means no command correlation.

contracts.purpose: Correlate a rejected command with a stable reason code.
contracts.semantics: It reports a decision made elsewhere and does not encode policy.

contracts.purpose: Request bounded exclusive command ownership.
contracts.semantics: Response repeats request_id; denial has a reason code.

contracts.purpose: Request relinquishment of an owned lease.
contracts.semantics: Release is explicit; clients do not infer it from request completion.

contracts.purpose: Request enabling or disabling a binding.
contracts.semantics: Acceptance does not itself grant command ownership.

contracts.purpose: Report recording or processing lifecycle for an episode.
contracts.semantics: State is observable at header.stamp; transitions are implemented elsewhere.

contracts.purpose: Associate timestamped operator, system, safety, or processing events.
contracts.semantics: Details are bounded and must not embed bulk data or secrets.

contracts.purpose: Reference workcell, task, configuration, calibration, and producer provenance.
contracts.semantics: Raw recordings and later derived operations remain separately identifiable.

contracts.purpose: Report a bounded machine-readable validation finding.
contracts.semantics: Evidence is an immutable reference; start/end use ROS time.

contracts.purpose: Record a short success, failure, or annotation marker.
contracts.semantics: The returned event_id identifies the accepted marker.

contracts.purpose: Control a cancellable long-running recording and return an artifact reference.
contracts.semantics: Canceled results state whether a partial artifact was retained.

contracts.purpose: Validate an immutable recording with progress and bounded findings.
contracts.semantics: Progress is normalized and result findings are capped at 256.
